correctness.rationale: For even k>=6 the weight-four words are precisely the two-whole-pair supports (weight formula, not an experiment). Their membership signatures force the intrinsic pairs. Every possible automorphism must preserve pairs; the swap-mask parity identity proves exactly the even-flip subgroup, and any permutation lifting a k-cycle on pairs into one 2k-cycle would require odd swap parity. For k=4 use the unique cyclic binary [8,4] code and distance; for k=2 an explicit cyclic equivalent. The standalone verifier exhaustively checks all 46080 paired permutations at k=6 and all permutations at k=2,4; it is not used as infinite proof.
